name: Driftwood
summary: Watcher Biggs sends you east to the coast for dry driftwood. He needs it to mend his wagon before he can reach Nethergarde.

sections.title: Wood for the Wagon
sections.body: Watcher Biggs thanks you and asks for help again. His wagon needs repairs before he can reach Nethergarde. The swamp's wood is too spongy and tangled to use, so he needs strong, dry wood.

sections.title: Driftwood from the Coast
sections.body: Watcher Biggs sends you east to the coast for driftwood dried by the sun. Bring eight pieces back to him in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why does Watcher Biggs need wood?
faq.answer: Biggs needs wood to mend his wagon so he can reach Nethergarde. The swamp's trees are too spongy and tangled.

faq.q: Where does Watcher Biggs send you for the wood?
faq.answer: He sends you east to the coast for driftwood dried by the sun.
The Lost Caravan comes first. Biggs then asks you for more help.
Eight pieces of driftwood dried by the sun.
